result.label: Source-read

claims.claim: A debt buyer may not sue to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on its claim has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.

claims.claim: A debt buyer may not start arbitration to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on its claim has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.

claims.claim: A debt buyer may not start another legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on its claim has expired.
claims.quote: A debt buyer shall not bring suit or initiate an arbitration or other legal proceeding to collect a consumer debt if the applicable statute of limitations on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.

result.summary: Section 1788.56 supports all three prohibitions and the stated condition that the limitations period on the debt buyer’s claim has expired.
